Anya Li: Quick heads-up: pushing SDK 4.0.2 tomorrow 07:00 PT — small security fix + telemetry header rename. Please read the short note: https://intranet.redwood.local/docs/guides/sdk-4-0-2-security
Samir Rao: What telemetry header is changing? Any customer-facing impact?
Anya Li: Old header X-Redwood-Usage -> new header X-RW-Telemetry. New header is shorter and canonicalized; we also strip PII. Hosted will accept old header for 45 days with deprecation warnings. Dedicated/Private have a 120-day grace period.
CS: Will customers see errors during the switch?
Anya Li: No hard errors expected. We will emit deprecation-warning headers and an audit event to Console when we detect legacy headers. We added a Console filter: Admin -> Auth Telemetry -> Header Type. CS will get a weekly export of any customers still sending X-Redwood-Usage.
Docs-bot: Published update: /docs/guides/sdk-4-0-2-security, added migration snippet and small audit runbook.
Security-bot: Note: ensure eng-runtime approves the header canonicalization PR and that edge proxies perform header normalization before ratelimit checks.
Anya Li: Action items: eng-runtime to review PR #842, docs to add the audit runbook screenshot, CS to prepare outreach template for customers still on legacy header after 30 days. Ping me for blockers. Thanks!
